mentions.name: Portable electrical cloud chamber
mentions.description: This device is a portable, sturdy electrical cloud chamber that makes ionising radiation visible to the naked eye on a desk. It is controlled by an ESP32, can run automated cooling benchmarks to find the power-versus-temperature sweet spot, and is built almost entirely from metal (drilled, cut, and tapped) rather than 3D-printed parts. It is functional but still needs tweaks and adjustments before it is fully finished.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been on-and-off working on a portable, sturdy electrical cloud chamber for a couple of months now. It's a device that lets you see ionising radiation with a naked eye, right on your desk.
